translation:
Sudden outbreak of epidemic eye disease, painful and hard to open; epidemic eye disease is contagious, with photophobia and fear of the sun. The white orb grows sores, millet-like grains cause hidden irritation, the lids swell and the lid margins ulcerate, and the lashes curl inward. Fleshy growths climb over the eye, red sinews pierce the pupil, films and membranes cover the eye, and curtain-like films and barriers form. Tears flow when facing the wind, pus issues from a leaking eye, the poison of cold damage flows, and the black orb sinks. The black orb protrudes, styes break out from time to time, the lid flesh produces glue, and wind pulls the mouth and eye askew. Night blindness and fixed staring; when struck and broken, films are produced, blood pours into the pupil spirit, and flying dust injures the eye. It breaks out from time to time with a root, the lids are hard and swollen, the pupil spirit is swollen and painful, and it breaks out from time to time with irritation. The outer canthus is red and irritated, and the inner canthus is red and irritated. Ice-wheel films, plum-blossom films, spiral-conch films, floating films, solid films, damp films, dry films, nail-head films, white films, red films, blue films, yellow films, black films, and films that break out and disperse from time to time.

The interior is urgent and the exterior relaxed; injuries from falls and blows.
translator_notes: 時眼 (shiyan) refers to epidemic conjunctivitis.
雀目 (quemu) is night blindness; 凝睛 (ningjing) is a fixed, unmoving eye.
胬肉攀睛 (nurou panjing) is a pterygium covering the eye.
